mapper.select:
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0
and (post_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or brand like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or model_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and board_type = #{boardType} and post_status = #{postStatus} and city like concat('%', #{city}, '%') order by create_time desc, post_id desc
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and post_no = #{postNo} and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post p inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.member_id = p.member_id and m.is_delete = 0 where p.member_id <> #{memberId} and p.post_status = 1 and p.is_delete = 0
and (p.post_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.brand like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.model_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.legal_subject_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and p.board_type = #{boardType} and p.city like concat('%', #{city}, '%') order by p.down_rank_flag asc, p.recent_30d_turnover desc, p.create_time desc, p.post_id desc

select from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post p inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.member_id = p.member_id and m.is_delete = 0 where p.post_no = #{postNo} and p.post_status = 1 and p.is_delete = 0 limit 1
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and post_no = #{postNo} and is_delete = 0 limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post (tenant_id, member_id, board_type, post_no, category, brand, model_name, memory_spec, condition_level, quantity, price_range_code, city, service_tags, recent_30d_turnover, idle_qty, rented_qty, long_idle_qty, post_status, down_rank_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{boardType}, #{postNo}, #{category}, #{brand}, #{modelName}, #{memorySpec}, #{conditionLevel}, #{quantity}, #{priceRangeCode}, #{city}, #{serviceTags}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), #{remark}, 0)
mapper.select: select unit_id from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post_inventory where post_id = #{postId} and is_delete = 0 order by post_inventory_id
mapper.update: update ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post_inventory set is_delete = 1, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and post_id = #{postId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post_inventory (tenant_id, member_id, post_id, unit_id, unit_code, serial_number, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{postId}, #{unitId}, #{unitCode}, #{serialNumber}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)
mapper.update: update ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post set board_type = #{boardType}, category = #{category}, brand = #{brand}, model_name = #{modelName}, memory_spec = #{memorySpec}, condition_level = #{conditionLevel}, quantity = #{quantity}, price_range_code = #{priceRangeCode}, city = #{city}, service_tags = #{serviceTags}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now(), remark = #{remark} where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and post_no = #{postNo} and is_delete = 0 and post_status in (0, 3)

update ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post set post_status = #{postStatus}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and post_no = #{postNo} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_market_message (tenant_id, post_id, from_member_id, to_member_id, message_content, read_flag, risk_flag, create_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{postId}, #{fromMemberId}, #{toMemberId}, #{content}, 0, 0, now(), 0)
mapper.update: update ry_rental.ry_rental_market_message set read_flag = 1 where message_id = #{messageId} and to_member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select r.report_id, p.post_no, coalesce(nullif(reported.nickname, ''), nullif(reported.legal_subject_name, ''), reported.member_code, '未知商户') as reported_merchant_name, r.report_type, cast(r.evidence_json as char) as evidence, r.report_status, r.review_result, date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(r.review_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as review_time from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_report r inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post p on p.post_id = r.post_id left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member reported on reported.member_id = r.reported_member_id and reported.is_delete = 0 where r.reporter_member_id = #{memberId} and r.is_delete = 0 order by r.create_time desc, r.report_id desc

select report_id, report_type, report_status from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_report where post_id = #{postId} and reporter_member_id = #{reporterMemberId} and report_type = #{reportType} and report_status = 0 and is_delete = 0 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_market_report (tenant_id, post_id, reporter_member_id, reported_member_id, report_type, evidence_json, report_status, create_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{postId}, #{reporterMemberId}, #{reportedMemberId}, #{reportType}, #{evidenceJson}, 0, now(), 0)
